authority: Rigel 2026-10-24 retroactive G17 enforcement (StegVerse-org/.github#166); pattern StegVerse-Labs/StegDB#60 (eab2e773)
rule: Every check a folded workflow job ran is one group here; its step bodies are the original run blocks byte for byte, pinned by sha256, except the repairs listed. A new check is a new group (or a step in one), never a new workflow file.
path_filters: Dropped: every group runs on every pull_request and push to main (a superset of the original path-filtered runs). workflow_dispatch/schedule triggers are not carried (no manual dispatch, no cron).
repairs: The dispatcher's check job fetches the exact source anonymously before run_catalog.py runs (git init; anonymous fetch --depth 1 of the PR head or pushed sha by URL; detached checkout). It adds no named remote, so each folded job's own anonymous fetch step (git init / git remote add origin / fetch / checkout) still runs byte for byte inside its group.

Step bodies that read their own workflow file (the 'Confirm ... authority boundary' / 'non-authorizing scope' assertions: permissions: {}, no actions/checkout, no actions/setup-python, no persist-credentials, cancel-in-progress) read the verbatim record under tools/tasks/folded/ instead of .github/workflows/; the assertions are unchanged and still hold.

capability-runtime.verify's OS x Python strategy matrix (ubuntu/windows/macos x 3.11/3.12) is six groups with matrix_values {os, python}; the dispatcher's check job runs each on runs-on: matrix.runs_on.

tests/test_sdk_install_constraints.py and tests/test_workflow_action_pins.py also read tools/tasks/folded/ (the verbatim records whose run blocks run_catalog.py verify pins byte for byte to the executed step bodies), so the M-P8 constraint guard and the M-P9 pin guard keep covering the folded install steps and actions.

stegverse-governance.yml's one job is a job-level `uses:` of StegVerse-org/StegVerse-SDK governance-gate.yml pinned at 1126f80e9fd179daf3dcfdbc45b59122f5e4cb8b; a run block cannot call a reusable workflow, so the job is carried verbatim as the dispatcher job `stegverse-governance` (same pin, same with:); the folded workflow's `contents: read` grant, which the called gate requests, is carried to that job only.
